title: SpaceX installs $250m worth of Tesla Megapack batteries at Starbase data center site in Texas - report
html:
SpaceX has reportedly installed more than $250 million worth of its Tesla Megapack battery energy storage system at its planned data center at Starbase, Texas.

The installation was revealed by Tesla investor Sawter Merritt on X.

“Wild. This site was literally just dirt less than 90 days ago. SpaceX is constructing this new data center at Starbase at breakneck speeds. Looks like over $250m of Tesla Megapacks have also been installed,” Merritt wrote on X. DCD has reached out to confirm the reports.

The energy build-out at the site is tied to recently publicized plans by the Elon Musk-owned firm to invest more than $24 billion into a new large-scale data center and co-located natural gas-fired power plant. Current plans envision the data center being powered behind-the-meter, not relying on the broader grid.

Plans for the data center were revealed earlier this month, with the project slated for construction on a 444-acre tract just east of the City of Brownsville, between Boca Chica Blvd and the Port of Brownsville, in Cameron County. SpaceX has since secured a major air pollution permit for the data center, following the resumption of environmental reviews for data centers in Texas earlier this month. However, the company also saw its application for a tax break for the project rejected by the Cameron County Commission.

This is not the first time SpaceX has deployed its Megapack system at one of its data centers. In May of last year, it was reported that the company's AI division (then known as xAI) installed 168 Megapack units at its Colossus supercomputer in Memphis, Tennessee. The deployment followed significant controversy at the site, after it was revealed that the company had installed 35 on-site methane gas turbines at the Memphis supercomputer. The turbines had a combined capacity of 422MW, more than double the permitted amount.

The Tesla Megapack battery is a lithium-ion-powered utility-scale battery energy storage unit. According to the company, each unit can store more than 3.9MWh of energy and is deployed in containers, allowing for modular scalability.
summary: Company seeking to develop up to $24bn data center and natural gas power plant at the site
